info.title: MacroTracker server API
info.description: REST API for the MacroTracker app, web app and agents. MCP is served separately at /mcp.

bearer.description: A session access token from /v1/auth/login, or a personal access token (mt_pat_…).

get.summary: Readiness: database and auth service reachable

get.description: The app calls this when a server URL is entered, to check it is a compatible MacroTracker server.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Exchange a refresh token for a new session
post.description: Apps send `refresh_token` in the body. Browsers send nothing in the body: the httpOnly cookie is used, and the `x-csrf-token` header must match the `mt_csrf` cookie.

post.summary: Redeem an invite or password-reset link and set a password
Change password; signs out every other device

get.summary: Devices signed in to my account

delete.description: Its access token stops working at once and its refresh token is refused.

post.summary: Create a personal access token (for MCP and agents)
post.description: The token is returned once; only its hash is kept.
Creates the account and returns an invite link for the admin to pass on. No email is sent.
Also works for someone whose invite expired.

delete.summary: Delete an account and all its data
